ex.zh: 我要怎麼停用這個網站的帳號？

ex.en: That accounts for why the door was open.
ex.zh: 這就說明了門為什麼是開著的。

ex.en: Exports account for 60% of the company's sales.
ex.zh: 外銷占公司銷售額的六成。

ex.en: He was absent from school on account of illness.
ex.zh: 他因為生病沒來上學。

ex.en: The game was canceled on account of the rain.
ex.zh: 比賽因為下雨而取消。

ex.en: Do you know accounting?
ex.zh: 你懂會計嗎？

ex.en: She studied accounting in college.
ex.zh: 她大學念會計。

ex.en: Please send an acknowledgment when you receive the files.
ex.zh: 收到檔案後請回覆確認。

ex.en: We received an acknowledgment from the supplier.
ex.zh: 我們收到供應商的確認回覆。

ex.en: The acquirer plans to retain the existing management team.
ex.zh: 收購方計畫留任現有管理團隊。

ex.en: The acquirer completed its review of the target company.
ex.zh: 收購方已完成對目標公司的審查。

ex.en: An actuary calculated the premium using the company"s claims data.
ex.zh: 精算師根據公司的理賠資料計算保費。

ex.en: The insurer hired an actuary to assess long-term risks.
ex.zh: 保險公司聘請精算師評估長期風險。

ex.en: The policy covers accidental damage to the rental car.
ex.zh: 這份保單承保租賃車輛的意外損壞。

ex.en: Their meeting was accidental, but it led to a useful partnership.
ex.zh: 他們偶然碰面，卻因此促成一項有益的合作。

ex.en: The listing includes the acreage and boundary map.
ex.zh: 房屋刊登資訊附有土地面積和界線圖。

ex.en: The farm"s acreage is large enough for an additional greenhouse.
ex.zh: 這座農場的土地面積足以再增建一座溫室。

ex.en: The hotel staff were very accommodating.
ex.zh: 飯店員工都很樂意配合。

ex.en: Thank you for being so accommodating with our schedule.
ex.zh: 謝謝你這麼配合我們的時程。

ex.en: I saw a white cloud sailing across the sky.
ex.zh: 我看見一朵白雲飄過天空。

ex.en: He had the impudence to cut across our garden.
ex.zh: 他竟然厚著臉皮穿過我們的花園。

ex.en: The pharmacy is across the street.
ex.zh: 藥局在對街。

ex.en: He lives across the river.
ex.zh: 他住在河的對岸。

ex.en: I have never come across such a stubborn person.
ex.zh: 我從來沒碰到過這麼倔的人。

ex.en: I ran across an old friend near the bank.
ex.zh: 我在銀行附近巧遇一位老朋友。

ex.en: Tom is accountable to me.
ex.zh: 湯姆要向我負責。

ex.en: Legal frameworks exist to hold war criminals accountable.
ex.zh: 法律制度的存在，就是為了追究戰犯的責任。

ex.en: We took action immediately so that things wouldn't get worse.
ex.zh: 我們立刻採取行動，以免情況惡化。

ex.en: I believe that his action was in the right.
ex.zh: 我相信他採取的行動是對的。

ex.en: You must take responsibility for your own careless actions.
ex.zh: 你必須為自己粗心的行為負責。

ex.en: I don't have to take responsibility for Tom's actions.
ex.zh: 我不必為湯姆的行為負責。

ex.en: She acknowledged having made a mistake.
ex.zh: 她承認自己犯了錯。

ex.en: You should acknowledge your failure.
ex.zh: 你應該承認自己的失敗。

ex.en: She acknowledged that my statement was true.
ex.zh: 她承認我說的是事實。

ex.en: Please acknowledge receipt of this email.
ex.zh: 收到這封電子郵件請回覆確認。

ex.en: They never acknowledged my application.
ex.zh: 他們始終沒有回覆確認收到我的申請。
